# Antimetal

> The AI platform that handles everything that happens after you deploy — so your engineers can focus on building.

Antimetal is the intelligence layer for engineering teams to better manage their software systems and infrastructure by investigating, diagnosing, fixing, and preventing issues in production. Built for platform engineering, DevOps, and on-call teams, Antimetal connects your cloud platforms, observability tools, and code to automate incident response, reduce MTTR, and eliminate alert fatigue. Teams using Antimetal resolve production incidents faster, reduce recurring failures, and ship with greater reliability. SOC 2, GDPR, and HIPAA compliant.

## Product

- [Diagnose](https://antimetal.com/diagnose): Get the full picture for every production incident instantly. Antimetal performs automated root cause analysis by correlating alerts, logs, metrics, code changes, and past incidents across your observability stack — so your on-call team understands what broke and why in minutes, not hours.
- [Fix](https://antimetal.com/fix): Stop firefighting. Get production-ready fixes generated with full context of your system — your stack, your history, your code. Antimetal replaces manual runbooks with AI-generated remediation tailored to your environment.
- [Prevent](https://antimetal.com/prevent): Stop incidents before they happen. Antimetal proactively identifies hidden risks, performance bottlenecks, and recurring failure patterns in your infrastructure — so you can fix them before they become production incidents.
- [Get Answers](https://antimetal.com/get-answers): Ask any question about your systems and get accurate answers instantly — no dashboards, no docs, no hunting down the one engineer who knows. Built for platform and site reliability teams managing complex distributed systems.

## Guides

- [What is AI for Incident Response?](https://antimetal.com/explore/ai-for-incident-response): AI for incident response refers to the use of AI systems to investigate, diagnose, and resolve production incidents by reasoning across logs, metrics, alerts, code, and system changes.
- [What is Antimetal?](https://antimetal.com/explore/what-is-antimetal): Antimetal is an AI system that helps engineering teams understand, diagnose, and improve production systems by reasoning across logs, metrics, alerts, code, and past incidents.
